Last month i moved all my projects from a genocidal git company to #Forgejo and now i just finished installing @penpot@fosstodon.org on my #RaspberryPi 5. The documentation is perfect so deploying it using #docker is so easy! Made some minor configs so it also plays nice with #Caddy and @tailscale@hachyderm.io. Want to learn #Penpot well so i can move from #Figma. #SelfHosting is so awesome 🥺
